import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] tree;
    static int modVal;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line = br.readLine();
        if (line == null) return;
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        modVal = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int x = eulerFunc(modVal);
        int l = n + 5;
        long[] fact = new long[l + 1];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= l; i++) {
            fact[i] = (long) i * fact[i - 1] % modVal;
        }

        if (n <= 3) {
            System.out.println(0);
        } else {
            long[] dp = new long[2000];
            dp[0] = 1; dp[1] = 2; dp[2] = 2; dp[3] = 1;
            tree = makeTree(2005);
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                update(i, (int) dp[i]);
            }
            int m = 3;
            long ans = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 3; i++) {
                long[] dp0 = dp.clone();
                long ans0 = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < i + 3; j++) {
                    for (int k = 1; k < m + 2; k++) {
                        long sum = getSum(j + k + 1, 2004);
                        ans0 = (ans0 + sum * dp0[k - 1]) % modVal;
                        dp[j + k] = (dp[j + k] + dp0[k - 1]) % modVal;
                        update(j + k, (int) dp[j + k]);
                    }
                }
                m += i + 3;
                ans = (ans + (long) f(i + 4, n) * ans0) % modVal;
            }
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }

    static int[] makeTree(int n) {
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            if (i >= n * 2) {
                return new int[i];
            } else {
                i *= 2;
            }
        }
    }

    static void update(int i, int x) {
        int offset = tree.length / 2;
        i += offset;
        tree[i] = x;
        i /= 2;
        while (true) {
            if (i == 0) break;
            tree[i] = tree[2 * i] + tree[2 * i + 1];
            i /= 2;
        }
    }

    static long getSum(int s, int t) {
        int offset = tree.length / 2;
        s += offset;
        t += offset;
        long ans = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (s > t) break;
            if (s % 2 == 0) {
                s /= 2;
            } else {
                ans += tree[s];
                s = (s + 1) / 2;
            }
            if (t % 2 == 1) {
                t /= 2;
            } else {
                ans += tree[t];
                t = (t - 1) / 2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static List<Integer> primeFactorize(int n) {
        List<Integer> ans = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
            while (n % i == 0) {
                ans.add(i);
                n /= i;
            }
            if (n == 1) break;
        }
        if (n != 1) ans.add(n);
        return ans;
    }

    static int eulerFunc(int n) {
        List<Integer> factors = primeFactorize(n);
        Set<Integer> p = new HashSet<>(factors);
        long x = n;
        for (int i : p) {
            x = x * (i - 1) / i;
        }
        return (int) x;
    }

    static long f(int a, int b) {
        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = a + 1; i <= b; i++) {
            ans = (ans * i) % modVal;
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
